release_gate.reason: The tracked aggregate requires an unchanged-runtime disposition against signed v1.0.11; the measured runtime is the composition's v1.1.0 pin, whose runtime differs from v1.0.11, so the gate refuses by design.

runtime_identity_quality.limitation: Repeated single-nibble digests are treated as placeholder-pattern identities; they bind the retained run consistently but do not establish authenticated deployment trust identity.

statistical_limits.limitation: Recorded percentiles are empirical descriptions of retained samples; the aggregate supplies no confidence interval, repeated-run inference, or population-level performance claim.
